description.value: A Chinese seafood restaurant located in Surrey offering delivery and takeout services. Provides dining options for touring cyclists seeking a meal between rides.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The prefetch from https://www.kingdo.ca/ confirmed this is an active Chinese seafood restaurant with delivery and takeout services at the stated Surrey address. The website content was minimal (front page only, 157 bytes) with no mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or other cyclist-specific amenities. The business is confirmed open and accessible as a food venue.
concerns: Website content minimal (front page only); no phone number available
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open, publicly accessible food business. Touring cyclists may use it for meals regardless of specific amenity offerings.
